SELECT cls.FINISH_DATE , cls.EXCEPTION_START_DATE , cls.EXCEPTION_END_DATE
, IF(cls_exc.JOB_NO IS NOT NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS BL_EXCEPTION_YN
, CASE WHEN cls.EXCEPTION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND cls.EXCEPTION_END_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(#{srchDate}, #{format}) >= cls.EXCEPTION_START_DATE AND STR_TO_DATE(#{srchDate}, #{format}) <= cls.EXCEPTION_END_DATE THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END ELSE 'N' END AS DATE_EXCEPTION_YN , CASE
WHEN cls_exc.JOB_NO IS NOT NULL THEN 'N'
WHEN STR_TO_DATE(#{srchDate}, #{format}) <= cls.FINISH_DATE THEN CASE WHEN cls.EXCEPTION_START_DATE IS NOT NULL AND cls.EXCEPTION_END_DATE IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN STR_TO_DATE(#{srchDate}, #{format}) >= cls.EXCEPTION_START_DATE AND STR_TO_DATE(#{srchDate}, #{format}) <= cls.EXCEPTION_END_DATE THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END ELSE 'Y' END ELSE 'N' END AS ADMIN_FINISH_YN
FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS_CLOSING cls
LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS_CLO_EXC cls_exc ON cls.ENT_CODE = cls_exc.ENT_CODE AND cls.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = cls_exc.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AND cls.SOLUTION = cls_exc.SOLUTION AND cls_exc.JOB_NO = #{srchOblJobNo}
WHERE cls.ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND cls.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{srchEntBusinessCode} AND cls.SOLUTION = #{srchSolution} AND cls.CLOSING_TYPE = #{srchClosingType}
SELECT ENT_BUSINESS_PRINT_NAME FROM TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS WHERE ENT_BUSINESS_CODE = #{entBusinessCode}
